headline: Iran intends to seek $290 billion in compensation from the United States
summary: Iran intends to seek compensation totalling $290 billion from the United States, according to a statement by the head of a centre of lawyers and official experts.
why: Claims of this size between states are largely political signalling, but they add to the sanctions and diplomatic tensions that weigh on oil and regional risk assets.
original_headline: Иран намерен взыскать с США компенсации на 290 миллиардов долларов
